title: Water Works without Electric Company under cash pressure
description: Water Works without Electric Company under cash pressure. Water Works alone is a low-priority utility and Alpha needs liquidity near orange. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.
